name: Head Crusher
summary: Image-plane selection where the user frames a distant object between thumb and forefinger as if crushing it.
howItWorks: Seen from the user's eye, the object that appears between the two fingers is selected; one of several image-plane techniques proposed by Pierce et al.

relationships.note: Same family of image-plane techniques (Pierce et al. 1997).
